design_brief.description: Model a folding whip RF antenna module as a tapered cylindrical whip with a fixed straight base section and a hinge/pivot located along the axis. Include a defined panel gap region near the base to accommodate washers and nuts. Overall geometry must match specified total length and diameters, with the pivot positioned 20.6 mm from the base and a fixed straight section of 20.6 mm from the base to the pivot.

sketch.prompt:
Draw a clean, minimalistic orthographic technical line sketch of the described object on a white background. Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: A folding whip RF antenna module: 108.5 mm total length, 9.5 mm base diameter, 7.9 mm tip diameter, 20.6 mm fixed straight section, pivot 20.6 mm from the base, 6.45 mm panel gap for washers and nuts.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): whip_body_tapered, fixed_straight_section, pivot_hinge_axis
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — primary_dimension = 108mm (category: generic).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.
APPROX DIMENSIONS: L_total≈108.5mm, D_base≈9.5mm, D_tip≈7.9mm, L_fixed≈20.6mm, pivot_from_base≈20.6mm, panel_gap≈6.45mm
NOTE: Assumes a simplified hinge represented by an axis and envelope dimensions (hinge_body_L, hinge_body_D). Exact hinge knuckle geometry and fastener sizes are optional unless further specified.

Keep the final image below 1024x1024, clean white background, no text outside the dimension labels, no watermark.
